response.original_title: Riccardo Chailly & Lukas Sternath Festival de Lucerne 2026 (version intégrale)
response.overview: Since the summer of 2019, the Lucerne Festival Orchestra and Riccardo Chailly have been taking audiences on a journey through Sergei Rachmaninoff’s symphonic and concertante world, featuring both essential works and rarities, such as his early opera "Aleko".  But before you discover the magic of his music, let yourself be carried away by his Piano Concerto No. 4, performed by the young pianist Lukas Sternath.
response.title: Riccardo Chailly & Lukas Sternath Festival de Lucerne 2026 (version intégrale)
